svg.aria-label: Ring count and falloff exponent compared
svg.text: Ring count, at a fixed falloff exponent of 1.6
Same glow width and peak alpha. There is no banding to see, not even at one ring — the piecewise-linear ramp is enough.
Falloff exponent, at a fixed 6 rings
This is the knob that changes the look. The ring count only decides how closely the exponent can be followed.
What the ring count actually buys
Each ring adds one sample point on the target curve. Three already sit close enough that the eye cannot separate them.
